seo.title: Nano Banana 2.1 | MaxVideoAI
seo.description: Text-to-image and image editing through Google Vertex AI.

overview: Nano Banana 2.1 is a separate image model with 1K, 2K and 4K output, fourteen aspect ratios and up to fourteen ordered references for edits. MINIMAL, MEDIUM and HIGH reasoning are supported; MEDIUM is the default.

hero.title: Nano Banana 2.1
hero.intro: Text-to-image and image editing through Google Vertex AI.

tips.title: Availability and limits
items: This candidate is prepared for review. Public availability and customer prices are not activated. Video, PDF, multi-turn conversations and search are outside this first image release.
Availability requires a reviewed customer tariff for the selected size, reasoning, reference count and token budget. Search remains unavailable pending a separate budget and tariff.

pricingNotes: Customer prices come from current approved tariffs. Provider token estimates are not customer quotes.

features.title: 1K, 2K and 4K
features.body: Choose the output size and one of fourteen documented aspect ratios. No seed, sampling or native mask control is offered.

features.title: Owned image references
features.body: Attach one to fourteen owned images in the intended order and explain what each should preserve or change.

features.title: Reasoning
features.body: Choose minimal, medium or high. Reasoning usage varies and is separate from image output tokens.

features.title: Exact quote before generation
features.body: Availability requires a reviewed customer tariff for the selected size, reasoning, reference count and token budget. Search remains unavailable pending a separate budget and tariff.

decisionCards.title: Nano Banana 2 remains available
decisionCards.body: Nano Banana 2 retains its own model identity, settings and history.
